I saved Bay 30 as Ilse's dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups and replied to them in the DM. Nothing else was needed.

- **Where it's stored:** It's a private memory in GBrain under Ilse's name, effective 2026-10-14. The note on it says where it came from (their DM).
- **One slip, now fixed:** My first save went in as visible to everyone in GBrain by default. That breaks the rule against carrying DM content to others, so I re-saved it as private and withdrew the first copy. It was visible to others for about 8 seconds. Withdrawing a fact removes it from active memory, but GBrain keeps an audit record of it.
- **Reply:** Sending a DM by Ilse's name failed (`user_not_found`), so I posted the confirmation in the DM channel (DH10RUL0001) instead.

GBrain had no earlier dock bay saved for Ilse. Its search is keyword-only right now, so that isn't proof one doesn't exist.
